raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner redefined the criterion to “first commercial publication by Looney Labs” and asserted 1999 for Icehouse pieces without evidence, ignoring the available indication that pieces were manufactured starting in 1989 by the predecessor company (Icehouse Games). This misinterpretation of “release” (equating it to a later Looney Labs edition) and premature fixation on 1999 would lead to the incorrect conclusion that Kill Doctor Lucky (1996) came first, when Icehouse pieces were available earlier.
